messages.subject: Robust form of MLM
parts:
Dear,

I tested my model fit using the estimation of MLM (robust form). I was suggested that I should use results from Robust column. But now when I rerun my model I found that there are also some lines indicating Robust results. For example, Robust Comparative Fit Index (CFI), Robust Tucker-Lewis Index (TLI), Robust RMSEA. You can see more clearly the results as following. So can anyone so kind to explain me this situation and then tell me which results should I use for my study.
Thank you very much
